subject: Re: Steps to rotate / revoke Redwood Hosted API key
body:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@northwind-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 6:06 PM
Subject: Steps to rotate / revoke Redwood Hosted API key

Hey Vanessa,
We think an API key may have been exposed in CI logs. Can you confirm the quickest way to rotate it? Also, does revocation take effect immediately?

Thanks,
Morgan

---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@northwind-analytics.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 6:19 PM
Subject: Re: Steps to rotate / revoke Redwood Hosted API key

Hi Morgan,
Yes  if you suspect exposure, the safest sequence is:
1) Disable/revoke the existing key in Console (Settings  API Keys  Disable).
2) Regenerate/create a replacement key.
3) Deploy the new key via your secrets manager and redeploy services.

Revocation is designed to be immediate (requests will start returning 401). In rare cases weve seen edge cache propagation take up to ~60 seconds.

Important: please dont send the key value in email or the ticket. If you need help locating the key record in Console, we can work off the key name/id.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success  Redwood Inference

---
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@northwind-analytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 6:47 PM
Subject: Re: Steps to rotate / revoke Redwood Hosted API key

Got it. We disabled first and are rolling the new secret now. Thanks for confirming the 401 behavior.

---
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@northwind-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 7:02 PM
Subject: Re: Steps to rotate / revoke Redwood Hosted API key

Thanks Morgan. If you see any intermittent 401s, its usually an old worker still running with the prior secret. Happy to help you track those down  share request IDs (not the key) and timestamps.
